title: Why do leaves change colour?
examples: Teacher, why does the leaf turn red?
Does the tree get sick when the leaves change colour?
What happens to the leaves in the fall?

explain.say: Look at the leaf. It is green right now.

draw.text: Leaves are green because of chlorophyll.

explain.say: Chlorophyll is like a green food maker for the leaf.

draw.text: Chlorophyll makes food for the leaf.

explain.say: When it gets cooler, the leaf stops making so much chlorophyll.
When the green fades, we see other colours hiding inside.

draw.text: Yellow and red colours show through.

explain.say: In the autumn, the tree keeps its energy safe for next year.

draw.text: Tree saves energy for winter sleep.

explain.say: Think about a crunchy autumn leaf on the ground.

draw.text: Leaves change colour in the fall.

faq.q: Why do leaves change colour in the fall?
faq.a: The change happens because the leaf stops making the green stuff called chlorophyll.
asks: What makes the leaves change colour?
Do leaves change colour because it is cold?

faq.q: Is the colour change because of the cold weather?
faq.a: The cold weather tells the tree it is time to get ready for sleep, which causes the change.
asks: Is it the cold that makes the leaves fall?
Why does the season change the leaves?

faq.q: Are the yellow and red colours always there?
faq.a: Yes, the yellow and red colours are always in the leaf, but the green colour covers them up.
asks: Why do we only see the colours in autumn?

faq.q: Do the leaves fall off the tree?
faq.a: Yes, the tree lets the leaves go so they do not lose too much energy in the cold.
asks: Do the trees shed their leaves?
What happens to the leaves when they fall?

faq.a: Chlorophyll is the green substance that helps the leaf make its own food using sunlight.
asks: What does chlorophyll do for the plant?

facts: Chlorophyll is the pigment that makes leaves look green.
Yellow and red colours are pigments already in the leaf.
As autumn approaches, the tree reduces chlorophyll production.
This process helps the tree save energy for the winter.

quiz.say: The green colour of leaves comes from:
quiz.why: Chlorophyll is the substance that captures sunlight for the plant.

wrong.0: The cold air makes the leaves fall, but it does not create the green colour.
wrong.1: Yellow pigments are colours that are already there, not the source of the green.
wrong.2: Sunlight is needed for the process, but chlorophyll is the actual green substance.

quiz.say: When chlorophyll fades, what colours become more visible?
quiz.why: These other colours were always in the leaf, just hidden by the strong green colour.

wrong.0: White is not a pigment that shows through the leaf in autumn.
wrong.1: Dark green is what is present when the leaf is healthy in summer.
wrong.3: Blue and purple colours are not usually part of the natural fall colour change.

quiz.say: If the tree stops making chlorophyll, what is it doing?
quiz.why: The tree prepares itself for the colder, less growing months ahead.

wrong.1: The change is a natural process, not a sign that the plant is ill.
wrong.2: Blooming happens in spring, not when the leaves are changing colour in autumn.
wrong.3: The process of making food slows down because the energy source is limited.
